aggregation: Median of per-round medians for warm boundaries; median of five process samples for CLI.

transformation.samples: All 70 original samples, in original order, projected without changing retained values.
transformation.metadata: CPU, model-config hash and post-run native hashes added; revisions/dependency versions grouped by variant label; local paths and full reports/stdout omitted.
transformation.comparisons: Recomputed over retained local full reports at documented tolerance; predict and replay checked separately.
transformation.native_hash_timing: Hashes were captured after the original run, before the later preflight attestation feature; they are not retroactive preflight evidence.
